about.title: About Ofogh Pars
about.story: Hooshmand Noavaran Ofogh Pars was founded in Shiraz on more than two decades of hands-on experience in software development and IT infrastructure management. Our goal is simple: to make technology a dependable tool for businesses. From early networked transportation and payroll systems to today's web applications and data-driven solutions, our path has always been built on continuous learning and solving real customer problems.
about.ceoBio: Mohammad Khorshidi holds a B.Sc. in Mathematics (Computer Science major) from Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (graduated 1996). His professional career began in 1997 developing software for transportation companies, and since 2001 he has managed the IT infrastructure of a large organizational branch. Beyond full-stack development with C#, ASP.NET, React and Next.js, he holds CCNA and CompTIA Network+ certifications, completed the Data Science Architect program (IntelliPaat, 2025), and actively uses AI-assisted development (vibe coding) in his projects.
